summary: - **[key4hep/k4geo#683](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/683)** — Sets the magnetic field to zero outside the muon systems of ALLEGRO, IDEA, CLD_o2_v09 and CLD_o5_v01, so escaping particles no longer curl back into the detector in simulation.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#681](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/681)** — Adds v02 shape- and CAD-based FCC-ee MDI collections using the simple CLD-style antisolenoid, and switches ILD_FCCee to the shape-based v02 MDI to fix ILD tracking.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses#565](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/565)** — Fixes get_V0s_jet and get_SV_jets to build each jet's V0s and secondary vertices from that jet's own tracks, which changes per-jet vertex outputs for every analysis using them.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses#569](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/569)** — Fixes get_PrimaryTracks wrongly dropping a compatible track and corrects the beam-spot-constrained vertex-fit degrees of freedom, changing primary-track selections and vertex chi2 values.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#128](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/128)** — GGTFTrackFinder identifies input hit collections by input-list position instead of unassigned CollectionIDs, fixing crashes and wrong hit-to-track assignments in ALLEGRO and IDEA reconstruction.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#80](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/80)** — ConformalTracking computes the interaction-point state of inside-out fits through an outside-in refit, avoiding double-counted inner hits and underestimated d0 and z0 uncertainties in CLD.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#152](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/152)** — CKF extrapolation to the interaction point includes beam-pipe material effects, giving realistic d0 and z0 uncertainties for low-momentum tracks in CLD.

- **[key4hep/k4RecCalorimeter#293](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/293)** — Adds optional re-centring of the sliding-window position window and an optional S-curve correction of per-layer theta barycentres, improving low-energy cluster positions in the ALLEGRO ECAL barrel.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses#538](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/538)** — Adds a DIRAC grid backend to fccanalysis submit that resolves EOS/XRootD or LFN inputs, plans deterministic jobs and submits through ILCDIRAC, replacing the submit --where syntax.

- **[AIDASoft/podio#1082](https://github.com/AIDASoft/podio/pull/1082)** — RNTupleReader reads only the requested collections and caches per-file views, making RNTuple reading about five times faster and skipping collections whose fields cannot be bound.
